cases.title: PF12 after typing a bad value re-reads the account and shows the stored values again
A valid change is redisplayed fully protected with 'Changes validated.Press F5 to save' (F5/F12 brightening is not observable here)
PF5 with a fresh change and no pending confirmation is treated as ENTER: it validates and asks for confirmation, nothing is written
ENTER while confirmation is pending keeps the confirmation screen and writes nothing
PF12 while confirmation is pending discards the change and shows the stored values

PF5 after confirmation rewrites account and customer: the blank group id is written as LOW-VALUES into ACCT-ADDR-ZIP because the update record has no zip field, and ACCT-GROUP-ID plus both record FILLERs take the never-initialized update-record FILLER (x'00' under the harness) (legacy bugs)
Saving a new group id, status and first name: the group id lands in ACCT-ADDR-ZIP and ACCT-GROUP-ID gets x'00' FILLER bytes (legacy bug); status and name are stored as typed
ENTER after a successful save clears the screen back to the account search
